diagnostics.message: Availability must be explicitly available or unavailable.
Unavailable data must not be represented as zero or an empty available result.
The API record does not conform to its schema.
The requested page exceeds the bounded pagination contract.
The pagination cursor is malformed or does not match the request.
The target identity is unknown or mismatched.
The canonicalization identifier is unsupported.
The domain-separated record digest does not match.
The extension namespace is invalid or conflicts with another owner.
The input is not strict JSON.
Only signed safe integers are admitted by canonical JSON V1.
Negative zero is not canonical.
The integer exceeds the cross-runtime safe range.
The input contains invalid Unicode.
An object contains a duplicate property.
Two property names collide after NFC normalization.
Canonical JSON V1 UTF-8 input must not contain a BOM.
The input exceeds the maximum canonical JSON nesting depth.
The timestamp is not canonical UTC second precision.
The target ID is not a lowercase F-line key.
The record kind cannot produce a digest domain.
The digest domain is invalid or unavailable.
A set-like array is not in canonical ordinal unique order.
The diagnostic code is not registered.
The diagnostic path exceeds its bound.
The diagnostic context exceeds its bound.
The diagnostic registry is malformed or non-deterministic.
The extension envelope does not conform to MEP V1.
The extension contains a forbidden authority-bearing field.
The extension contains a duplicate fragment ID.
The extension declares an unknown target.
The extension digest does not match canonical V1 material.
The extension closure contains a duplicate extension ID.
Two extensions claim the same namespace.
The extension does not declare the selected target.
A required extension dependency is absent.
The extension closure contains an active conflict.
The extension dependency graph contains a cycle.
The extension target array is not in canonical ordinal unique order.
